name: Jellyfish

personalities.followUp: It drifts lazily into the enemy...
It slowly floats toward its target...
It circles once before bumping the enemy...
It glides gracefully through the current...
It surges forward with surprising determination...

criticalText: It erupts in brilliant Astral light! Critical Hit!

perfectJellyfishScenes: The Jellyfish has achieved a level of focus previously thought impossible for a Jellyfish. Nobody knows what it's thinking. Whatever it is, it's working.
The Jellyfish becomes perfectly still. For once, not sleepy. Not sad. Not confused. It simply understands. A brilliant light pulses through its body before crashing into the enemy!
